entry.title: Likely: The vanilla Xiaomi 18 launches in December with 100W charging
entry.summary: A standard Xiaomi 18 is still coming this year, around December in China, with 100W wired charging, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, a 200MP main camera and a 7,200mAh battery.

entry.title: Likely: Standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e arrive in spring 2027
entry.summary: Apple is splitting its iPhone releases: Pro and foldable models in fall, the standard iPhone 18 and 18e in spring.

entry.title: Likely: OnePlus readies a Turbo 7 Pro with an unreleased Snapdragon 'Pro' chip and 100W charging
entry.summary: OnePlus is developing a Turbo Pro (possibly Turbo 7 Pro) with a new 3nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro (SM8845 Pro), a 6.78-inch 1.5K 185Hz screen, a 200MP main camera and a 9,000mAh battery, launching around the end of the year.

entry.title: Likely: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max cost EUR 1,449-1,849 in Europe with smaller batteries
entry.summary: The European Xiaomi 18 Pro will cost EUR 1,449 (256GB) or EUR 1,649 (512GB) with a 6,000mAh-rated battery and 90W charging, and the 18 Pro Max EUR 1,849 (512GB) with a 7,050mAh-rated battery and 100W, both smaller than the Chinese versions' 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh.

entry.title: Shaky: iPhone Duo 2 gets under-display Face ID
entry.summary: Apple's second-generation iPhone Duo, expected next fall, adds Face ID under the outer display, and Apple is also considering an Action button.

entry.title: Rumor: Motorola Edge 70 Neo has a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 7,000mAh battery and 144Hz screen
entry.summary: The Edge 70 Neo will have a 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera, 32MP selfie camera, 7,000mAh battery with 45W charging and IP64.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone Air 2 gets a 6.55-inch 120Hz screen, A20 chip and two 48MP rear cameras
entry.summary: The iPhone Air 2 launches next spring with a 6.55-inch flat 120Hz OLED, a 2nm A20-series chip, 48MP wide and 48MP ultrawide rear cameras and a bigger battery than the first Air.

entry.title: Rumor: One UI 9.5 lets Bixby run recurring tasks in the background
entry.summary: Samsung's One UI 9.5 turns Bixby into a task agent that can run scheduled, recurring jobs in the background (for example a daily exchange-rate report), managed from a new Actions menu with an activity log.

entry.title: Likely: One UI 9.5 lets Galaxy phones record WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet calls
entry.summary: Samsung's Phone app in One UI 9.5 adds a 'Record calls in other apps' setting with per-app toggles for VoIP calls in WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet, possibly limited by country.

entry.title: Confirmed: Samsung Health gets a Galaxy AI 'Scan meal' calorie estimator, possibly paid later
entry.summary: Samsung Health will add Scan meal, a Galaxy AI feature that identifies food, ingredients and portion sizes from a photo and estimates calories; it is labeled beta and its terms say it could become a paid feature.

entry.title: Likely: One UI 9.5 adds a 'Daily Brief' that summarizes your emails and app notifications
entry.summary: Samsung's Now Brief gains a Daily Brief that pulls notifications from apps such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, KakaoTalk and SMS/RCS plus your email, and sorts them into cards for finance and payments, bookings and appointments, and work email at a set time of day.

entry.title: Likely: Samsung held Quick Share's Tap to Share back for One UI 9.5
entry.summary: Quick Share's NFC Tap to Share, which Google promised for the Galaxy Z8 foldables 'soon' after the Pixel 11 launch, arrives on Galaxy phones with One UI 9.5 rather than earlier.

entry.title: Shaky: One Galaxy S27 model gets an 'extremely bezel-less' display
entry.summary: A Samsung supplier is preparing an 'extremely bezel-less' display, and Samsung may pull it forward into one of the Galaxy S27 models, most likely the Ultra or Pro.

entry.title: Likely: The iQOO Z12 Lite is a renamed Z11 Lite with a Dimensity 6300
entry.summary: iQOO's next budget phone, the Z12 Lite (model I2510), uses the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 with 4GB or 6GB of RAM, a 720x1600 screen with a waterdrop notch and Android 16, the same specs as the Z11 Lite.

entry.title: Rumor: Google's Pixel Tag goes on sale in the EU 'pretty soon'
entry.summary: Google will start selling the Pixel Tag Find Hub tracker in European Union countries soon; it launched with the Pixel 11 in eight countries including the UK but none in the EU.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple is developing four 20th-anniversary iPhones in two designs, curved and flat
entry.summary: Apple is working on four anniversary iPhone models: two with glass curving along all four edges and roughly 1mm bezels, and two with flat cover glass.

entry.title: Likely: Huawei's new sub-brand is called Osta and debuts with the flagship-level Osta O1 and wide-screen O1 Pro
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming sub-brand, reported in Chinese as Xingmang, will be called Osta in English and launch with two flagship-level phones: the Osta O1 with a quad-curved screen and the Osta O1 Pro with a 6.39-inch 1.5K wide-aspect flat screen and up to 16GB/1TB.

entry.title: Rumor: The 'iPhone 20 Pro' uses iPhone Air-style glass that curves on all four sides
entry.summary: Apple's 2027 anniversary Pro iPhones use the same glass material as the iPhone Air, shaped with more curvature so the front and back curve on all four edges around a thin polished metal frame.

entry.title: Rumor: Variable aperture returns on the Galaxy S28 Pro and S28 Ultra, not the S27
entry.summary: Samsung brings back a variable-aperture main camera on the Galaxy S28 Pro and S28 Ultra, which implies the Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra keep fixed apertures.

entry.title: Rumor: Oppo's next Pro Max hides its bezels under four-sided curved glass (about 0.3mm)
entry.summary: Oppo's next top flagship, likely the Find X11 Pro Max, pairs a flat panel with cover glass curved on all four sides for a visual bezel of about 0.3mm; the tech is pricey, so only top models get it and OnePlus stays flat.

entry.title: Rumor: Huawei Watch Air is a 6.9mm titanium smartwatch with up to 5 days of battery
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming Watch Air has a 6.9mm titanium unibody, an irregular high-silicon stacked battery (over 10% silicon) for up to five days of use, Watch GT 7 Pro-level activity tracking and Watch 6 sensors including ECG.

entry.title: Rumor: The 'iPhone 20 Pro' gets a new main camera sensor with a 17nm image processor
entry.summary: Apple's 2027 anniversary Pro iPhones use a new main camera sensor paired with a new image signal processor built on a 17nm process.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple unveils smart glasses at WWDC 2027
entry.summary: Apple will show privacy-focused smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them in late 2027.

entry.title: Confirmed: Huawei Mate X8 foldable launches in November
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate X8 in China in November with Kirin 9050/9050 Pro chips, an 8.15-inch inner and 6.5-inch cover screen, a 50MP 1/1.28-inch variable-aperture main camera, a 50MP periscope and a battery above 6,000mAh, plus a privacy-display version.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 cameras: Ultra drops to a single 5x telephoto, S27 Pro gets a 10MP 3x zoom
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27 and S27+ keep a 50MP main, 12MP ultrawide and 10MP 3x camera; the S27 Pro and Ultra share a 200MP ISOCELL HP6 main, a 50MP ultrawide and a 16MP selfie camera, but the Pro gets only a 10MP 3x telephoto and the Ultra a single 50MP 5x telephoto.

entry.title: Rumor: Intel's Razor Lake desktop line gets a 12 P-core gaming chip with big cache and no regular E-cores
entry.summary: Intel's 2028 Razor Lake-S lineup includes an unlocked '12+0+4' chip with 12 P-cores, four low-power E-cores and Intel's big Last Level Cache (bLLC), built on Intel 18A-P, replacing a planned 8+0+4 part; a 6+12+4 bLLC chip moves from Nova Lake to Razor Lake.

entry.title: Likely: Lenovo's Googlebook Duet 13 detachable launches in January
entry.summary: Lenovo's first detachable Googlebook, the Googlebook Duet 13, with a 13-inch screen, a detachable keyboard, a stylus and a kickstand cover, launches in January 2027.

entry.title: Shaky: iPhone 18e keeps a 60Hz screen but gets the A20 and possibly a 24MP selfie camera
entry.summary: The iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch 60Hz LTPS OLED screen, the 2nm A20 chip, a single 48MP rear camera and maybe a 24MP front camera.

entry.title: Rumor: Standard iPhone 18 gets a bigger battery and a higher price
entry.summary: The standard iPhone 18 will have a larger battery than the iPhone 17's 3,692 mAh (reportedly 4,430 mAh), keep a 6.3-inch 120Hz OLED with Dynamic Island, use the 2nm A20 and dual 48MP cameras, and may cost more.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo has a 12,000mAh-plus phone battery in mass production
entry.summary: vivo is already mass-producing a phone battery of 12,000mAh or more, with an even larger cell in development for a new large-screen device.
